name: ManifestWork
description: Defines a set of Kubernetes resources (manifests) to be applied on a specific managed cluster.
usageHint: Use ManifestWork to deploy manifests to a specific managed cluster from the hub.

workload.manifests: array of raw Kubernetes resources to apply on the managed cluster

spec.manifestConfigs: optional feedback and update strategies per resource

deleteOption.selectivelyOrphans: specific resources to orphan on deletion (optional)

status.conditions: standard Kubernetes conditions for work status

resourceStatus.manifests: status and feedback for each manifest applied to the cluster
